title: `array<T>` reads covariantly in its element type, because an array is a copy-on-write value
scope:
the variance of `array<T>` in the assignability relation, and nothing about the `as`
conversion that restamps one. What a *write* through a widened view is checked against is decided
here too, because it is the half that makes the read sound.
dependsOnText:
[0007](0007.md) (the element type and its invariance), [0002](0002.md) (copy-on-write
value semantics), [0125](0125.md) (`class<T>`'s covariance, the other road to the same answer).
